title: Find Company Emails and Phones in Seconds With LinkFinder AI
coverSub: Company emails and phone numbers, one at a time or a whole list
cover: This is LinkFinder AI. You give it a company name, a LinkedIn profile or a whole list, and it gives you back the contact data you need to reach them.
payoff: Here is where you end up: a list of companies, each with its real contact email, ready to export. Let's see how it works.
outro: One company or a thousand, the same few clicks. Lookups also run inside Google Sheets, through the API, or straight from your AI assistant. Grab your LinkFinder AI account and run your own list today.
outroSub: Emails, phones, LinkedIn data. One lookup or a whole CSV.
description: A quick look at LinkFinder AI: find a company's contact email and phone number from its name, then enrich a whole CSV list in one click. Every value shown comes from a real LinkFinder AI lookup.

mocks._source: Real results of the LinkFinder AI API already used in the video factory (data/lookups.json, 12-13 Nov 2026)

click.text: I just need one lookup for now

steps.narration: Start with one company. Open More searches and pick a company's contact email.

click.text: A company's contact email, from its name

steps.narration: Type the company name, Notion, and click Enrich Data.
Two seconds later: support at make notion dot com, their real contact inbox.
Need to call instead? Switch to phone number, same company.
The real power is lists. Go back to contact email and click Upload CSV.

click.text: A company's contact email, from its name

steps.narration: Drop in your file. Your columns stay as they are, and you see every row before anything runs.
Each row fills in as it runs.
Five companies in, five contact emails out. Export it as a CSV in one click.
